issue.title: Add a decisions strand: memory history is git-derived and its index is a disposable cache

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a decisions strand (e.g. memory-history-is-git-derived) recording that git is the only store for memory and instruction-file history, and that the sase-core memory_history per-scope snapshot under the cache dir is a disposable, incremental metadata index that can always be rebuilt from git. Cite plan:202609/memory_history.md (sections 2 and 5.3), the credible alternative (a separate history store or an append-only event log), its cost (a cold rebuild on cache loss, plus the honest-state labels for shallow and untracked files), and the condition that would reopen it (history that must outlive git, e.g. a squashed or rewritten history).

issue.creation_reason: Filed from sase-1dr.12 note #7 (tooling item 2) while landing epic sase-1dr; plan:202609/memory_history.md section 18 asks for this record as a memory task bead because memory edits need their own authorization.
